raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Follow-up to merged #55277: use compact 528-byte `fp8_ds_mla` rows for native NoPE on the FlashInfer SM120 backend. Rebased onto upstream main `e6674262f1`. Only tests conflicted: #55528 made the MLA KV-spec test's fake layer carry `attn_backend`, and the HiSparse test helper gained `max_union_rows`; both were resolved by keeping both sides. The two commits are now `aab1e922fa` and `e879b2ef44` (head), and the branch merges cleanly into current main.

The row contains 512 FP8 latent bytes and four FP32 group scales. There is no RoPE payload. A single backend-owned row-size method supplies both the KV spec and early HiSparse registration. On SM120, compact selection depends solely on `kv_lora_rank=512` and `qk_rope_head_dim=0`, independent of model name, connector, or offloading configuration. Other backend layouts are unchanged; real RoPE64 `fp8_ds_mla` retains 656-byte rows. No new dtype or CLI option is added.

The writer accepts NoPE 528/656, preserves legacy zero-tail behavior for 656, and rejects RoPE64 with 528. It distinguishes logical row width from physical stride. The fixed 576-dimensional gather rejects compact input. HiSparse uses actual row widths for byte movement and rejects incompatible shared-staging layouts.

No connector changes, layout negotiation, or old-cache migration are added. Local prefix caching remains supported. External connectors were not tested end to end.

Duplicate-work check: #53969/#55778/#55543 use padded compatibility layouts; #55219/#57169 address broader paging/stride plumbing, not this compact writer/spec change. The community B12X GLM_NEXT path already uses the same 528-byte encoding; that is a useful precedent, not the FlashInfer backend wiring implemented here. Reference: local-inference-lab/vllm `cff8aebfeb73de96c97b4c5a0550c5a49f27451c`, `b12x_mla_sparse.py`. FlashInfer compact-row support was merged in flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#5075.

## Test Plan

Validation used 4x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell for official NVIDIA GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4, TP4, BF16, no speculation, text-only, context 65536, max sequences 32, batched tokens 4096, FULL_AND_PIECEWISE graphs. FlashInfer source: `dc04f50c9aa3eabcdaa5feb0934edb3d85e9529a`.

Commands below are shown without local environment wrappers, not as verbatim execution transcripts. Paths are relative to the vLLM checkout unless noted. The following checks were rerun after the rebase onto main:

```bash
python -m pytest tests/kernels/attention/test_cache.py \
  -k concat_and_cache_ds_mla -q -rs
python -m pytest tests/kernels/test_cp_gather_fp8.py -q
python -m pytest -q \
  tests/v1/attention/test_mla_backends.py::test_mla_kv_cache_spec_uses_layer_cache_dtype \
  tests/v1/attention/test_sparse_mla_backends.py::test_hisparse_index_group_preserves_row_width \
  tests/v1/attention/test_sparse_mla_backends.py::test_hisparse_shared_staging_requires_uniform_row_width \
  tests/v1/attention/test_sparse_mla_backends.py::test_hisparse_swap_in_preserves_rows_across_eviction \
  tests/v1/attention/test_sparse_mla_backends.py::test_hisparse_gather_prefill_cache_prefers_resident_rows
prek run --from-ref c843f0cab78b413f2b0a5c2282cb71e3a3937b11 --to-ref bea90f7efee
```

Earlier validation from the FlashInfer checkout, not rerun after the rebase:

```bash
python -m pytest tests/attention/test_sparse_mla_sm120.py \
  -k glm53_nope_compact_rows -q
```

Model validation preceded gate removal and was not rerun after the rebase. It used GSM8K and random-8k1k workloads with `FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_SM120` explicitly selected. As in #55277, successful runs used the disclosed distributed-autotune workaround:

```text
VLLM_FLASHINFER_AUTOTUNE_SKIP_OPS=fp4_gemm,trtllm::fused_moe::gemm1,trtllm::fused_moe::gemm2
```

This PR does not fix that separate autotune issue or the noncanonical-layout calibration restriction. FlashInfer 0.6.18.post1, pinned in upstream vLLM, is not the dependency used for this validation.

## Test Result

### Revalidation after the rebase onto `e6674262f1` (head `e879b2ef44`)

Run on 4x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell with FlashInfer built from main (includes flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#5075) and vLLM's CUDA extension rebuilt from a tree containing this branch:

- CUDA writer (`test_cache.py -k concat_and_cache_ds_mla`): **9 passed, 3 skipped**. Fixed-layout gather (`test_cp_gather_fp8.py`): **18 passed**. KV-spec tests (`test_mla_backends.py -k kv_cache_spec`): **10 passed**.
- `tests/v1/attention/test_sparse_mla_backends.py`: **119 passed**, 7 failed. All 7 fail identically on `e6674262f1` without this PR: `test_sparse_backend_prefill_correctness[*-auto-masked_mha*]` for deepseek_hd192_v128, glm5_hd256_v256 and glm53_flash_nope_hd256_v256, and `test_hisparse_speculative_rows_resolve_host_misses_consistently[long_mtp]`.
- GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4, TP4, text-only, context 65536, max sequences 32, batched tokens 8192, `--kv-cache-dtype fp8`, default FlashInfer autotune (no skip-ops workaround). GSM8K through the chat template (1,319 problems, flexible-extract, concurrency 32):

| | Without this PR (656-byte rows) | With this PR (528-byte rows) |
|---|---:|---:|
| Engine-reported KV tokens | 3,234,669 | 3,972,729 (**+22.8%**) |
| GSM8K (chat, flexible-extract) | 0.973 | 0.972 |

Both evaluations ran on the same integration tree with unrelated changes for other models; one run each.

### Earlier results (before this rebase)

At head `bea90f7efee`:

- Selected spec and HiSparse width/guard/data-path tests: **31 passed, no skips**. Includes uint8 528/656 host miss, hit, eviction/reload, and prefill byte gather. No claim of a complete model-level HiSparse deployment or external-connector end-to-end test.
- CUDA writer: **9 passed, 3 existing unsupported-geometry/input-size skips**. Includes compact/padded rows, row/page gaps, invalid slots, and legacy payload parity.
- Fixed-layout gather regression: **18 passed**.
- All applicable `prek` hooks passed across **all 10 changed files**, including Ruff, formatting, and mypy.

Earlier validation, not rerun after the rebase:

- FlashInfer compact/padded/sliced cache attention parity and CUDA graph replay: 3 passed (before gate removal).
- Broader `test_mla_backends.py` attempt stopped after 53 passes at an SM100 CUTLASS-only operator unavailable in this SM90/SM120 build. The complete cross-architecture suite was not qualified.
- GSM8K strict match, #55277 parent → compact: **1223/1319 (92.72%) → 1228/1319 (93.10%)**, concurrency 32, max output 2048. The compact evaluation gate passed; +5 samples is not evidence of a meaningful accuracy gain. Its recipe initially failed the immediate cleanup check; a subsequent managed stop verified all allocated devices freed.
- Random 8K/1K: **both runs completed 252/252 requests with zero failures**, with 4 × concurrency requests per level. Matrix server cleanup verified.

### KV-cache capacity

Compared with #55277 on the same hardware and serving configuration:

| Metric | #55277 | Compact |
|---|---:|---:|
| Encoded bytes per KV row | 656 | 528 (**−19.51%**) |
| Engine-reported KV token capacity | 4,301,231 | 5,282,546 (**+22.81%**) |
| Available KV-cache memory | 40.57 GiB | 40.57 GiB |

The benefit is more KV capacity within the same memory budget, not a throughput claim or a 19.51% reduction in total GPU allocation. Capacity is engine-reported, not saturation-tested; the validation runs used dirty source trees with differing build metadata.

Developed with AI assistance. Opened as a draft pending human line-by-line review; automated validation is not represented as human review. No changes were pushed to #55277.

---

<summary> Essential Elements of an Effective PR Description Checklist </summary>

- [x] The purpose of the PR, such as "Fix some issue (link existing issues this PR will resolve)".
- [x] The test plan, such as providing test command.
- [x] The test results, such as pasting the results comparison before and after, or e2e results
- [ ] (Optional) The necessary documentation update, such as updating `supported_models.md` and `examples` for a new model.
</details>
